trigger_evidence.interpretation: The legal-masked root move proxy is behaviorally safe, authorizing the preregistered arena. Conventional validation did not establish a model improvement, so this arena is diagnostic and cannot by itself authorize Phase 2.

arena.rationale_for_direct_128_pairs: Prior 16-pair and 128-pair runs had nearly identical fixed startup and compilation overhead, and a 16-pair score failed to predict the decisive 128-pair result. A single 128-pair run is cheaper and more informative than staged duplicate launches.

analysis.primary_estimand: candidate score over complete color-swapped opening pairs
analysis.uncertainty: pair-aware 95% bounded interval plus paired logistic Elo interval
analysis.clearly_worse_rule: Reject behavioral parity if the pair-aware 95% score interval is wholly below 0.5.
analysis.phase2_rule: Do not authorize Phase 2 because the frozen validation comparator already failed. An unexpectedly strong arena may motivate a separately preregistered reassessment, not continuation of this arm.

post_arena_rule.candidate_selection: Hero 1 remains incumbent unless both behavioral evidence and predictive validation support replacement
post_arena_rule.next_branch_if_no_winner: preregister an objective or model intervention that removes unnecessary legality pressure and/or explicitly preserves the pretrained greedy policy
